title: A Cymbal Album Before Flying to Beijing
description: In his last days in Winnipeg before the fall semester in Beijing, Steven goes over his teaching schedule, his packing (mostly not done), a birthday dinner spent browsing magazines, and backing up 400GB of footage with the macOS Terminal. He also records an album using cymbals from his collection and asks whether kids should have to get a job before they're allowed on social media.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick Overview

sentences.zh: 史蒂文还在温尼伯过最后几天，心却早已飞到了北京。
sentences.en: Steven is spending his last few days in Winnipeg, but his heart has already flown to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 他梳理了秋季学期的课表，坦白自己连行李都没怎么收拾。
sentences.en: He went over his fall semester class schedule and admitted he had barely packed his luggage.

sentences.zh: 生日晚餐时，他和妈妈聊起杂志，忍不住吐槽了一番。
sentences.en: At his birthday dinner, he and his mom talked about magazines, and he couldn't help ranting a bit.

sentences.zh: 随后是用“终端”备份400GB素材、被延迟拖慢的镲片专辑，以及一个问题：玩社交媒体的孩子，该不该先去打工？
sentences.en: Then comes backing up 400GB of footage using the "Terminal," a cymbal album slowed down by delays, and a question: should kids who use social media get a job first?

sentences.zh: 秋季课表
sentences.en: Fall Class Schedule

sentences.zh: 下周二上午9点45分之前，史蒂文必须赶到北京，航班延误也不能当借口。
sentences.en: Steven has to get to Beijing before 9:45 a.m. next Tuesday, and a delayed flight is no excuse.

sentences.zh: 新学期安排如下：
sentences.en: The new semester is set up like this:

sentences.zh: 周二：9:45开始上课，约15名学生。
sentences.en: Tuesday: class starts at 9:45, with about 15 students.

sentences.zh: 午休是答疑时间，学生扫二维码预约。
sentences.en: The lunch break is for office hours, and students book a slot by scanning a QR code.

sentences.zh: 下午1:30至3:00还有一节课。
sentences.en: There's another class from 1:30 to 3:00 in the afternoon.

sentences.zh: 周三：9:45至11:30上课，午休和下午是答疑时间。
sentences.en: Wednesday: class from 9:45 to 11:30, with office hours over lunch and in the afternoon.

sentences.zh: 周四：没课。
sentences.en: Thursday: no classes.

sentences.zh: 周五：最忙的一天，三段课排得满满当当。
sentences.en: Friday: the busiest day, packed with three class sessions.

sentences.zh: 他带三个班，每班每周两次课。
sentences.en: He teaches three classes, and each class meets twice a week.

sentences.zh: 中国老师负责阅读和听力，史蒂文周二、周三教写作，周五教口语。
sentences.en: Chinese teachers cover reading and listening, while Steven teaches writing on Tuesdays and Wednesdays and speaking on Fridays.

sentences.zh: 语法也许能算第五项技能，不过他说：“算了，那是咬文嚼字。”
sentences.en: Grammar might count as a fifth skill, but he says, "Forget it, that's just splitting hairs."

sentences.zh: ⏰ 早起与第一周
sentences.en: ⏰ Getting up early and the first week

sentences.zh: 闹钟又要调回早上6点。
sentences.en: The alarm clock has to go back to 6 a.m. again.

sentences.zh: 计划是：7:30到8:30健身，9点出门，9:30到学校。
sentences.en: The plan: work out from 7:30 to 8:30, leave at 9, and get to school by 9:30.

sentences.zh: 住处在双井附近，离学校近，说不定直接跑过去。
sentences.en: He lives near Shuangjing, close to the school, so he might just run there.

sentences.zh: 他预感自己“又会把事情搞得太复杂”。
sentences.en: He has a feeling he'll "overcomplicate things again."

sentences.zh: 第一节课，他打算沿用上学期的破冰环节：不看手机，围绕一道雅思话题讲两分钟。
sentences.en: For the first class, he plans to reuse last semester's icebreaker: no phones, talk for two minutes on an IELTS topic.

sentences.zh: 他还想试试全班合写一篇作文，明知道“他们肯定会讨厌”。
sentences.en: He also wants to try having the whole class write an essay together, knowing full well "they'll definitely hate it."

sentences.zh: 去年，学生们管他叫“雷神”。
sentences.en: Last year, the students called him "Thor."

sentences.zh: 告别家人与（没）收拾行李
sentences.en: Saying goodbye to family and (not) packing

sentences.zh: 妈妈提议周五办一次家庭送别会，可史蒂文已经“没有家庭模式的心情了”。
sentences.en: His mom suggested holding a family farewell party on Friday, but Steven was already "not in a family-mode mood anymore."

sentences.zh: 他常常出远门，但承认：“我旅行的方式，大概可以当反面教材。”
sentences.en: He travels a lot, but admits: "The way I travel could probably serve as an example of what not to do."

sentences.zh: 真正不能缺的只有签证，其余都“无关紧要”。
sentences.en: The only thing he truly can't do without is his visa; everything else is "unimportant."

sentences.zh: 礼物：给女朋友带尼亚加拉瀑布钥匙扣，再给她和同事带枫糖浆口味的奥利奥。
sentences.en: Gifts: a Niagara Falls keychain for his girlfriend, plus maple-syrup-flavored Oreos for her and her coworkers.

sentences.zh: 给她爸爸的多半还是冰酒，送她妈妈的还没想好。
sentences.en: For her dad it'll most likely be ice wine again; he hasn't decided yet what to give her mom.

sentences.zh: 他把衣服在床上分成几堆，又全部放了回去。
sentences.en: He sorted his clothes into several piles on the bed, then put them all back again.

sentences.zh: “所以我什么也没干。”
sentences.en: "So I didn't do anything."

sentences.zh: 他会带一个大托运箱、一个背包，外加被加航弄坏的那只行李箱。
sentences.en: He'll bring a big checked case, a backpack, plus the suitcase Air Canada damaged.

sentences.zh: 关于这件事的投诉，他到现在还没写完。
sentences.en: He still hasn't finished writing his complaint about it.

sentences.zh: 延时摄影、健身短裤与免费相册
sentences.en: Time-lapse photography, gym shorts and a free photo album

sentences.zh: 他的健身短裤在多伦多被偷了，从此几乎没怎么锻炼。
sentences.en: His gym shorts were stolen in Toronto, and since then he has barely worked out.

sentences.zh: 多年来他一直拍跑步延时视频，却很少发布，因为找配乐太费时间，AI配乐也许能帮上忙。
sentences.en: For years he has been filming time-lapse videos of his runs but rarely posts them, because finding music takes too much time; AI-generated music might help.

sentences.zh: 他还拍起飞、降落、空镜和照片，打算把相册放进简介里的谷歌云端硬盘分享。
sentences.en: He also films takeoffs, landings, establishing shots and photos, and plans to share the album through a Google Drive link in his bio.

sentences.zh: 他只有一个请求：“别拿去干坏事。”
sentences.en: He has just one request: "Don't use them for anything bad."

sentences.zh: 生日晚餐与杂志架
sentences.en: Birthday Dinner and the Magazine Rack

sentences.zh: “祝我自己太阳转一圈快乐。”
sentences.en: "Happy trip around the sun to me."

sentences.zh: 生日那天，妈妈带他去了McNally Robinson书店。
sentences.en: On his birthday, his mom took him to McNally Robinson Booksellers.

sentences.zh: 枫糖野牛肉汉堡味道不错，就是“有点邋遢”。
sentences.en: The maple bison burger tasted good, just "a bit messy."

sentences.zh: 杂志架上已经找不到鼓类杂志，吉他、钢琴和电影制作的倒还在。
sentences.en: The magazine rack no longer had any drum magazines, though the guitar, piano and filmmaking ones were still there.

sentences.zh: 他怀念疫情期间停刊的《Cinefex》。
sentences.en: He misses Cinefex, which stopped publishing during the pandemic.

sentences.zh: 后几年的内容多是把照片扫描进电脑，在他看来“不过是给生活复印”。
sentences.en: In its last few years, the content was mostly photos scanned into a computer, which to him was "just photocopying life."

sentences.zh: 他一度被13美元的周日《纽约时报》勾得心动，转念想起自己曾在《华尔街日报》的一个版块上耗了八个小时，便作罢。
sentences.en: For a moment he was tempted by the $13 Sunday New York Times, but then he remembered once spending eight hours on a single section of the Wall Street Journal, and gave up the idea.

sentences.zh: 400GB、终端与标题党
sentences.en: 400GB, the Terminal, and Clickbait

sentences.zh: 他用macOS的终端，把近两周的400GB素材备份了一遍：用diff对比文件夹，用rsync先预览、再复制缺失的文件。
sentences.en: He used the macOS Terminal to back up 400GB of footage from the past two weeks: diff to compare folders, and rsync to preview first, then copy the missing files.

sentences.zh: 速度“快得离谱”，连进度条都没有。
sentences.en: It was "ridiculously fast" — there wasn't even a progress bar.

sentences.zh: 终端看着吓人，只因它“就是屏幕上的一堆文字”。
sentences.en: The Terminal only looks scary because it's "just a bunch of text on the screen."

sentences.zh: 接下来的问题是：做按天记录的流水账，还是讲故事的视频？
sentences.en: The next question: make a day-by-day log, or a storytelling video?

sentences.zh: “2026年9月4日，星期五，布法罗”这种日期标题，在他的频道上从来没火过。
sentences.en: Date titles like "Friday, September 4, 2026, Buffalo" have never taken off on his channel.

sentences.zh: 夸张表情加惊人说法，才有点击量。
sentences.en: Exaggerated faces plus shocking claims are what get clicks.

sentences.zh: 他打趣说，如果自己终于要这么干了，那“说明风向要变了”。
sentences.en: He joked that if he finally does it himself, that "means the winds are about to change."

sentences.zh: 镲片专辑
sentences.en: The Cymbal Album

sentences.zh: 在老家阁楼卧室里，史蒂文正在录一张用库存镲片做成的专辑。
sentences.en: In the attic bedroom of his childhood home, Steven is recording an album made with the cymbals he has in stock.

sentences.zh: 这既是处理掉镲片前的一次音色盘点，也是一个创作项目。
sentences.en: It's both a way to take stock of the cymbals' sounds before getting rid of them and a creative project.

sentences.zh: 《Let It Ride》叠了一只叮叮镲、一只带铆钉的镲、一只杰克·德约内特的镲和一只爵士叮叮镲，速度约120 BPM。
sentences.en: "Let It Ride" layers a ride cymbal, a riveted cymbal, a Jack DeJohnette cymbal and a jazz ride, at about 120 BPM.

sentences.zh: 在Logic Pro里，它总是比节拍慢一帧。
sentences.en: In Logic Pro, it always lags one frame behind the beat.

sentences.zh: 把音频文件挪一挪就好了，不过“我的节奏感确实还得练”。
sentences.en: Nudging the audio file fixes it, but "my sense of rhythm really does still need practice."

sentences.zh: 他的耳机还会把节拍器的声音漏进麦克风。
sentences.en: His headphones also leak the metronome into the microphone.

sentences.zh: 目前完成了一首，他希望周六还麦克风之前能录出五六首。
sentences.en: So far one track is done, and he hopes to record five or six before returning the microphone on Saturday.

sentences.zh: 节目末尾只播放片段，因为Spotify已经下架了他早期的一些音乐节目。
sentences.en: Only excerpts are played at the end of the episode, because Spotify has taken down some of his early music episodes.

sentences.zh: 玩社交媒体的孩子该打工吗？
sentences.en: Should kids who use social media get a job?

sentences.zh: 晚餐时，话题转到了孩子玩社交媒体。
sentences.en: Over dinner, the conversation turned to kids using social media.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的看法是：“不喜欢看到的内容，就别玩社交媒体。”
sentences.en: Steven's view was: "If you don't like what you see, then stay off social media."

sentences.zh: 他自己发的无害内容也会遭到辱骂。
sentences.en: Even the harmless content he posts himself gets abusive comments.

sentences.zh: 想玩社交媒体的孩子，是不是该先有份工作？
sentences.en: Should kids who want to use social media have a job first?

sentences.zh: 这样屏幕时间可能会减少，发帖也会更谨慎。
sentences.en: That way their screen time might go down, and they'd be more careful about what they post.

sentences.zh: 服务员说，这要看父母。
sentences.en: The server said it depends on the parents.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文反驳：孩子管不住，社交媒体也管不住。
sentences.en: Steven pushed back: you can't control kids, and you can't control social media either.

sentences.zh: 他们会用朋友或表亲的账号，也正是这样才练出“街头智慧”。
sentences.en: They'll use a friend's or cousin's account, and that's exactly how they develop "street smarts."

sentences.zh: 另一方面，社交媒体也能教会孩子经商、纳税、讲故事和公开演讲。
sentences.en: On the other hand, social media can also teach kids about business, paying taxes, storytelling, and public speaking.

sentences.zh: “正反两面我都能辩。”
sentences.en: "I could argue either side."

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 史蒂文即将迎来第一个完整学期，周五的课排得满满当当，镲片专辑却让他放不下手。
sentences.en: Steven is about to start his first full semester, and his Friday classes are packed, but he can't let go of his cymbal album.

sentences.zh: 他的建议是：去录那张你一直想做的专辑吧，哪怕只是“用笔敲桌子”。
sentences.en: His advice: go record that album you've always wanted to make, even if it's just "tapping a pen on the table."

vocab.en: a negative example to learn from
